summary: SLC-05 killers: 7 green (missing-file refuse seal, stamp on seal+snapshot + amend immutability, latest amend wins, backfill preserves prior seals/N.json, deleted file fails check+audit, CLI amend/check-seal round-trip, hostile .. specPath). Red: (1) audit seal-digest-drift only compares live sealPayload to seal.specDigest — forging seal.specDigest to the new live hash greens ledger:audit while snapshot body drifts (check-seal still fails). (2) lastExpectedDocDigest truthy-checks afterDocDigest so empty string falls through to seal.specDocDigest, erasing a prior real amend — check-seal goes green after file revert.
plainSummary: Audit can still pass after a forged seal hash, and an empty amend digest can wipe a real plan-change record so check-seal looks fine.

findings.gap: auditLedger seal-digest-drift compares only computeSpecDigest(ws) !== ws.seal.specDigest. Pitch / SLC-05 require live sealPayload ≠ seal snapshot body. Mutating title and rewriting seal.specDigest to the new live hash yields audit findings=[] (CI green) while check-seal still fails on stale snapshot.specDigest. Killer: packages/ledger/src/workstream/doc-digest.break.test.ts::audit seal-digest-drift: live≠snapshot body even if seal.specDigest forged to match live
findings.plainImpact: Someone could change a sealed plan's JSON and still get a clean audit by rewriting the seal hash, as long as they never ran check-seal.
findings.fixProposal: Emit seal-digest-drift when live digest ≠ snapshot.specDigest (or ≠ hash of snapshot.body), not only when live ≠ seal.specDigest. Keep check-seal and audit aligned.

evidence.observedOutput: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: audit must emit seal-digest-drift when live payload ≠ snapshot body; got []

findings.gap: lastExpectedDocDigest: if amends.length && last.afterDocDigest (truthy) return it; else seal.specDocDigest. Empty-string afterDocDigest is falsy → falls through past a prior real amend. Attack: amend to v2, append poison amend with afterDocDigest:"", revert file to seal bytes → check-seal.ok===true (expected===sealDigest) while priorAmend still on disk. Pitch: if any postSealAmends exist, use latest afterDocDigest (do not soft-skip to seal). Killer: packages/ledger/src/workstream/doc-digest.break.test.ts::out-of-intent: empty afterDocDigest on latest amend must not fall back past prior amend
findings.plainImpact: A bad empty amend entry could erase an earlier real plan change so the old sealed doc would look valid again.
findings.fixProposal: When postSealAmends is non-empty, always take the latest afterDocDigest (including empty → missing-expected or hard fail). Do not fall back to seal.specDocDigest while amends exist. Optionally schema-minLength≥1 on afterDocDigest.
